items.title: I asked Trayce Jackson-Davis about Scottie Barnes throwing down a 360 dunk:
items.author: Wolstat
items.body_excerpt:
I asked Trayce Jackson-Davis about Scottie Barnes throwing down a 360 dunk:
"Every time he slams it, it's nuts. I like it because it gets him going too. It gets the crowd into it, and sometimes we need that, especially when we get it off to a slow start."

items.title: Didn't think I'd be musing 4 games in whether Trayce Jackson-Davis should be starting at C for Raptors, but here we are. Darko didn't seem to trust him last year, but has given him a few chances so far. Delivering tonight.
